# batch-summary: `SummarizeOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout batch summarize TABLE --by COLS --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `batch summarize`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/batch-summary.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/batch-summary.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema batch-summary`.

## Types

### SummaryOutput

A summary: one row per group and value column.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group_by` | array of `string` | yes | Columns that define a group: `by` plus the measurement dimensions added. |
| `added_dimensions` | array of `string` |  | Dimensions added automatically. |
| `values` | array of `string` | yes | Value columns summarized. |
| `replicate` | `string` or `null` |  | Replicate column, if any. |
| `test` | `string` or `null` |  | Test and control, if any. |
| `control` | `string` or `null` |  | The control group (value of the first `by` column). |
| `rows_used` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Table rows used / left out (errors, filters, missing values). |
| `rows_excluded` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Rows left out by filters or errors. |
| `table` | [`Table`](#table) | yes | The summary table. |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Things to know. |

### Table

A table: columns and rows of cells in column order.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | array of [`Column`](#column) | yes | Columns. |
| `rows` | array of array of [`Value`](#value) | yes | Rows; each has one cell per column. |

### Column

One column.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name (stable; units that never change are part of it, e.g. `sample_rate_hz`). |
| `type` | [`ColumnType`](#columntype) | yes | Inferred type. |
| `unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Unit of every value in the column, when fixed. |
| `role` | [`Role`](#role) | yes | What the column holds. |
| `description` | `string` or `null` |  | One line on its meaning. |

### ColumnType

Column type, inferred from the cells.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"string"` | Text. |
| `"integer"` | Whole numbers. |
| `"float"` | Real numbers (a column mixing integers and reals is `float`). |
| `"boolean"` | `true`/`false`. |

### Role

What a column holds.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"id"` | Which data set a row comes from: `path`, `format`, `files`. |
| `"key"` | The row's position within its data set (the measure's grain): `channel`, `population`, `well`, `parameter`, … |
| `"annotation"` | Joined from a sample sheet or plate layout. |
| `"metadata"` | Recorded in the file's own metadata (sample id, well, instrument). |
| `"value"` | A measured or computed value. |
| `"error"` | `error`, `error_code`. |

### Value

One cell.

Type: `boolean` | `integer` (int64) | `number` (double) | `string` or `null`.

### WrittenFile

What was written.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `format` | [`TableFormat`](#tableformat) | yes | Its format. |

### TableFormat

A table file format.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"csv"` | Comma-separated values with a header row. |
| `"tsv"` | Tab-separated values with a header row. |
| `"jsonl"` | One JSON object per row and line. |
| `"json"` | `{"columns": [...], "rows": [[...], ...]}`. |
| `"parquet"` | Apache Parquet (Snappy), with column metadata. |
